labels.name: Name
labels.sampleHint: JPEG/PNG: 5,000,000 bytes. MP4/PDF: 16,000,000 bytes. Select a fresh file for each submission.
labels.variablesHint: Use contiguous positional variables starting at {{1}} in each component. Header: at most one. Supply an example for every variable.
labels.buttonValue: Static URL or international phone number

messages.accepted: Meta accepted the operation. Approval and send readiness are separate. Refresh to check the current status.
messages.editWarning: Changes affect this WABA account-wide and can break campaigns, journeys and AI sends. Last accepted save wins. Unsaved changes are not stored.
messages.submitWarning: Submit this complete definition to Meta? Changes may break existing sends. Meta controls review and editing restrictions.
messages.deleteWarning: Delete this exact name/language variant from this WABA for all users? Existing sends may break. Deletion can remain pending; approved names may not be immediately reusable.
messages.unknownOutcome: The outcome is unknown. Refresh the catalog before retrying; Meta may already have accepted the operation.
messages.catalogIncomplete: Could not load the complete template catalog. Refresh and try again; saved selections are preserved.
messages.catalogDeadline: Template catalog loading exceeded the time limit.
messages.invalidName: Use 1–512 lowercase letters, digits or underscores for the template name.
messages.invalidText: Provide nonempty text within the displayed component limit (button URLs: 2,000 characters).
messages.invalidVariables: Variables must be contiguous from {{1}} in each component. Header supports one; footer and buttons support none.
messages.invalidExamples: Provide an example for every variable.
messages.invalidSample: Select a nonempty JPEG/PNG (up to 5,000,000 bytes), MP4 or PDF (up to 16,000,000 bytes) matching the header.
messages.invalidButtons: Use at most 10 buttons, two static HTTP(S) URLs and one international phone number. Group quick replies together.
messages.unsupported: This format is view-only in CRM. Use Meta Manager.

tooltips.templateId: The unique Meta ID for this message template
tooltips.components: JSON representation of the template structure (header, body, footer, buttons)
